Every donation address on this site is one of the CCS wallet’s subaddresses, taken from a list made once, offline, from a view-only copy of the wallet, and signed with a key made only for that. The secret key was destroyed right after signing, so no other list can ever carry that signature. The site is checked against the list each time it is made: an address that is not in it is never shown.

You can check it yourself, with nothing from this site but the files below:

  1. Download the list, its signature and the public key.

  2. Check the key’s fingerprint against the one the CCS maintainers publish elsewhere (in the design repository, in its README), then:

    gpg --import subaddresses.txt.key.asc
gpg --verify subaddresses.txt.asc subaddresses.txt

  3. Look for the address you are about to pay to:

    grep -c " THE_ADDRESS$" subaddresses.txt

    1 means it is the wallet’s. 0 means do not send: tell the CCS maintainers.

The key’s fingerprint: {{fingerprint}}

Or ask the wallet itself

The wallet’s address and view key are public ({{wallet_source}}), so you can also ask a copy of the wallet whether an address is one of its own, without the list. A view key can’t spend; it only shows what the wallet received.

The wallet’s address: {{address}}

Its view key: {{viewkey}}

With monero-wallet-rpc from the Monero CLI (getmonero.org, check its hashes as the site explains), offline, in one terminal:

monero-wallet-rpc{{network}} --offline --wallet-dir ccs-check --rpc-bind-port 18088 --disable-rpc-login

and in another:

rpc() { curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18088/json_rpc -d "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":0,\"method\":\"$1\",\"params\":$2}"; }
rpc generate_from_keys '{"filename":"ccs","address":"{{address}}","viewkey":"{{viewkey}}","password":""}'
rpc set_subaddress_lookahead '{"password":"","major_idx":1,"minor_idx":20000}'
rpc get_address_index '{"address":"THE_ADDRESS"}'

"index":{"major":0,"minor":…} means it is the wallet’s. Address doesn't belong to the wallet means do not send: tell the CCS maintainers. (The lookahead makes the copy look at its first 20,000 subaddresses; a fresh one only looks at 200.) Delete the ccs-check folder when done.
